messages:
Alex: quick heads-up — CI flagged a regression on the 1F1B schedule after the kernel-selector change. throughput dropped ~12% on 8xA100 for long-seq workloads.
perf-bot: 🚨 perf-regression detected: run 2026-03-17 18:04 - metric=pp_latency_p99, delta=+12%
Sam: which kernel change landed?
Alex: the selector started preferring fused-attn-v2 for long seqs (landed yesterday). local repro shows more all-reduce stalls in the pipeline.
Maria: profiling snapshot i took on the failing run:
```
timeline:
  GPU0 compute 0.42s | allreduce wait 0.18s
  GPU1 compute 0.40s | allreduce wait 0.19s
kvcache:
  hit_rate: 92%
  spills: 8% -> writes increased around stage 3
microbatch: 4 (default)
observation: bubble width grows at stage 3/4, allreduce tail adds ~150-200ms per step
```
Kai: interesting — fused-attn-v2 reduces per-token compute but looks like it changes KV write pattern / layout, so more bytes sent to all-reduce. that could inflate comm time even if compute is cheaper.
Tariq: can you share nvprof / NCCL timeline? also need to confirm if allreduce switched from ring->tree in the NCCL version we pinned.
Alex: nvprof attached in CI artifact (link). quick manual runs: mb=2 cuts bubble ~40ms but increases scheduler overhead. enabling kvcache.preload/prefetch in runtime cut allreduce wait by ~35% in the toy repro.
Sam: can you paste the runtime config you tested?
Alex: sure:
```
runtime.config:
  kernel_selector: "fused-attn-v2"
  microbatch_size: 2
  kvcache.prefetch: true
  tp_shard_strategy: "pairwise"
  nccl_version: 2.12
```
Maria: another angle — fused kernel launches many smaller kernels which increases kernel-launch overhead and shifts timing so allreduce calls line up worse across ranks. heuristic should account for comm alignment, not just per-kernel latency.
Kai: propose a simple scoring function for selector: score = compute_latency + lambda * allreduce_bytes. lambda tuned per cluster (net bw). if score lower, pick kernel even if raw compute slightly higher.
Tariq: +1. i'll run a grid: microbatch in [1,2,4,8], kvcache.prefetch {on,off}, selector score lambda in [0.5,1,2], across 4/8 GPUs. will capture NCCL timeline + host tracers.
Alex: flagged as P1 for investigation. i'll open a short-lived opt-out: env KERNEL_SELECTOR=fallback-attn to revert on noisy clusters.
perf-bot: ticket created: RF-4212 - ppchain 1F1B perf regression investigation.
Sam: nice. once Tariq has sweep results we can decide: tweak selector scoring, adjust microbatch defaults for 1F1B, or add automatic kvcache prefetch for long-seq.
Maria: also watch for KV spill behavior — if spills > 5% we should probably prefer kernels that reduce write churn even at compute cost.
Tariq: running sweeps tonight, will post condensed timeline + flamegraph link. assigning follow-ups: @Alex open PR for selector flag, @Tariq run sweep, @Maria add kvcache metric to perf dashboard.
Alex: will do PR now. thanks team. :thumbsup:
